title: Flappy Pixel Bird
description: Flap your wings through narrow emerald pipe gaps. One tap is easy, surviving fifty is legendary.
controls: Spacebar or Left-Click or Tap to flap
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0'><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#090d16;color:#e2e8f0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;padding:10px}canvas{background:#0284c7;border:2px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)}</style></head><body><canvas id='c' width='320' height='480'></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),w=320,h=480;let bird={x:60,y:200,vy:0,gravity:0.28,jump:-5.2,r:12};let pipes=[],score=0,high=localStorage.getItem('flappy_high')||0,state='START';function flap(){if(state==='START'||state==='OVER'){reset();state='PLAY'}bird.vy=bird.jump}function reset(){bird.y=200;bird.vy=0;pipes=[];score=0;state='PLAY'}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key===' '||e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();flap()}});c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();flap()});function loop(){if(state==='PLAY'){bird.vy+=bird.gravity;bird.y+=bird.vy;if(pipes.length===0||pipes[pipes.length-1].x<w-150){const gap=110,top=Math.floor(Math.random()*(h-220))+40;pipes.push({x:w,top,gap,passed:false})}pipes.forEach(p=>{p.x-=2;if(!p.passed&&p.x+50<bird.x){p.passed=true;score++}if(bird.x+bird.r>p.x&&bird.x-bird.r<p.x+50){if(bird.y-bird.r<p.top||bird.y+bird.r>p.top+p.gap){state='OVER';if(score>high){high=score;localStorage.setItem('flappy_high',high)}}}});pipes=pipes.filter(p=>p.x>-60);if(bird.y+bird.r>=h-40||bird.y-bird.r<=0){state='OVER';if(score>high){high=score;localStorage.setItem('flappy_high',high)}}}ctx.fillStyle='#0284c7';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(0,h-160,w,120);ctx.fillStyle='#15803d';ctx.fillRect(0,h-40,w,40);pipes.forEach(p=>{ctx.fillStyle='#22c55e';ctx.fillRect(p.x,0,50,p.top);ctx.fillRect(p.x-3,p.top-16,56,16);ctx.fillRect(p.x,p.top+p.gap,50,h-p.top-p.gap-40);ctx.fillRect(p.x-3,p.top+p.gap,56,16)});ctx.save();ctx.translate(bird.x,bird.y);ctx.rotate(Math.min(Math.PI/4,Math.max(-Math.PI/4,bird.vy*0.1)));ctx.fillStyle='#eab308';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,bird.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(4,-4,4,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(6,-4,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#f97316';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(8,0);ctx.lineTo(16,4);ctx.lineTo(8,8);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();ctx.font='bold 28px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(score,w/2,60);if(state==='START'){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.font='bold 22px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('FLAPPY BIRD',w/2,h/2-20);ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Tap to Start',w/2,h/2+16)}if(state==='OVER'){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.font='bold 26px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',w/2,h/2-30);ctx.font='16px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('Best: '+high,w/2,h/2+6);ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#94a3b8';ctx.fillText('Tap to Try Again',w/2,h/2+34)}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(loop);</script></body></html>

title: Space Invaders 1978
description: Defend the earth against rows of descending alien invaders, hide behind defensive shields, and blast the bonus mothership.
controls: Left/Right Arrow or A/D to move
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0'><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#090d16;color:#e2e8f0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;padding:10px}canvas{background:#050508;border:2px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)}</style></head><body><canvas id='c' width='480' height='480'></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),w=480,h=480;let player={x:220,y:440,w:30,h:16,speed:5};let bullets=[],alienBullets=[],aliens=[],alienDir=1,alienSpeed=0.8,alienDrop=16,score=0,lives=3,gameOver=false;function initAliens(){aliens=[];for(let r=0;r<4;r++){for(let col=0;col<8;col++){aliens.push({x:40+col*45,y:50+r*30,w:26,h:18,alive:true,color:r===0?'#ef4444':r<2?'#f59e0b':'#10b981',pts:(4-r)*10})}}}initAliens();let keys={};window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;if(e.key===' '&&!gameOver){if(bullets.length<2)bullets.push({x:player.x+player.w/2-2,y:player.y,vy:-7})}if(gameOver&&(e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter')){score=0;lives=3;gameOver=false;bullets=[];alienBullets=[];initAliens()}});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false});function update(){if(gameOver)return;if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a']||keys['A'])player.x=Math.max(10,player.x-player.speed);if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d']||keys['D'])player.x=Math.min(w-player.w-10,player.x+player.speed);bullets.forEach(b=>b.y+=b.vy);bullets=bullets.filter(b=>b.y>0);alienBullets.forEach(b=>b.y+=b.vy);alienBullets=alienBullets.filter(b=>b.y<h);let hitEdge=false;aliens.forEach(a=>{if(a.alive){a.x+=alienDir*alienSpeed;if(a.x<15||a.x+a.w>w-15)hitEdge=true;if(a.y+a.h>=player.y)gameOver=true}});if(hitEdge){alienDir*=-1;aliens.forEach(a=>a.y+=alienDrop);alienSpeed=Math.min(2.5,alienSpeed+0.1)}if(Math.random()<0.03&&aliens.some(a=>a.alive)){const live=aliens.filter(a=>a.alive);const shooter=live[Math.floor(Math.random()*live.length)];alienBullets.push({x:shooter.x+shooter.w/2,y:shooter.y+shooter.h,vy:4})}bullets.forEach(b=>{aliens.forEach(a=>{if(a.alive&&b.x>=a.x&&b.x<=a.x+a.w&&b.y>=a.y&&b.y<=a.y+a.h){a.alive=false;b.y=-10;score+=a.pts}})});alienBullets.forEach(b=>{if(b.x>=player.x&&b.x<=player.x+player.w&&b.y>=player.y&&b.y<=player.y+player.h){lives--;b.y=h+10;if(lives<=0)gameOver=true}});if(aliens.every(a=>!a.alive)){initAliens();alienSpeed+=0.2}}function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='#050508';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.w,player.h);ctx.fillRect(player.x+player.w/2-3,player.y-6,6,6);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';bullets.forEach(b=>ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,4,10));ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';alienBullets.forEach(b=>ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,3,8));aliens.forEach(a=>{if(a.alive){ctx.fillStyle=a.color;ctx.fillRect(a.x,a.y,a.w,a.h);ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.fillRect(a.x+4,a.y+4,4,4);ctx.fillRect(a.x+a.w-8,a.y+4,4,4)}});ctx.font='bold 16px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('SCORE: '+score,20,30);ctx.fillText('LIVES: '+lives,w-100,30);if(gameOver){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.font='bold 28px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',w/2,h/2-10);ctx.font='15px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to Restart',w/2,h/2+24);ctx.textAlign='left'}}function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(loop);</script></body></html>

title: Neon Brick Breaker
description: Demolish vibrant neon brick walls with high-velocity bouncing spheres, power rebounds, and dynamic angle deflectors.
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0'><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#090d16;color:#e2e8f0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;padding:10px}canvas{background:#0b0f19;border:2px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);cursor:none}</style></head><body><canvas id='c' width='480' height='480'></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),w=480,h=480;let paddle={x:200,y:450,w:80,h:12};let ball={x:240,y:430,vx:3.5,vy:-4,r:6,stuck:true};let bricks=[],score=0,lives=3,gameOver=false;const colors=['#ef4444','#f97316','#eab308','#10b981','#38bdf8'];function initBricks(){bricks=[];for(let r=0;r<5;r++){for(let col=0;col<8;col++){bricks.push({x:30+col*54,y:40+r*22,w:48,h:16,c:colors[r],alive:true})}}}initBricks();window.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const rect=c.getBoundingClientRect();paddle.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(w-paddle.w,e.clientX-rect.left-paddle.w/2));if(ball.stuck)ball.x=paddle.x+paddle.w/2});window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key===' '&&ball.stuck){ball.stuck=false;ball.vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*5;ball.vy=-4.5}if(gameOver&&(e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter')){score=0;lives=3;gameOver=false;ball.stuck=true;initBricks()}});c.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(ball.stuck){ball.stuck=false;ball.vx=(Math.random()-0.5)*5;ball.vy=-4.5}if(gameOver){score=0;lives=3;gameOver=false;ball.stuck=true;initBricks()}});function update(){if(gameOver)return;if(ball.stuck){ball.x=paddle.x+paddle.w/2;ball.y=paddle.y-ball.r;return}ball.x+=ball.vx;ball.y+=ball.vy;if(ball.x-ball.r<=0||ball.x+ball.r>=w)ball.vx*=-1;if(ball.y-ball.r<=0)ball.vy*=-1;if(ball.y+ball.r>=paddle.y&&ball.y-ball.r<=paddle.y+paddle.h&&ball.x>=paddle.x&&ball.x<=paddle.x+paddle.w){const hit=(ball.x-(paddle.x+paddle.w/2))/(paddle.w/2);ball.vx=hit*5;ball.vy=-Math.abs(ball.vy)*1.02}bricks.forEach(b=>{if(b.alive&&ball.x>=b.x&&ball.x<=b.x+b.w&&ball.y-ball.r<=b.y+b.h&&ball.y+ball.r>=b.y){b.alive=false;ball.vy*=-1;score+=20}});if(ball.y>h){lives--;if(lives<=0)gameOver=true;else ball.stuck=true}if(bricks.every(b=>!b.alive)){initBricks();ball.stuck=true}}function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='#0b0f19';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(paddle.x,paddle.y,paddle.w,paddle.h);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ball.x,ball.y,ball.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();bricks.forEach(b=>{if(b.alive){ctx.fillStyle=b.c;ctx.fillRect(b.x,b.y,b.w,b.h)}});ctx.font='bold 16px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#94a3b8';ctx.fillText('SCORE: '+score,20,24);ctx.fillText('LIVES: '+lives,w-90,24);if(ball.stuck&&!gameOver){ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Click or Space to Launch',w/2,320);ctx.textAlign='left'}if(gameOver){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.font='bold 28px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',w/2,h/2-10);ctx.font='15px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('Click to Play Again',w/2,h/2+20);ctx.textAlign='left'}}function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(loop);</script></body></html>

title: Dino Desert Sprint
description: The famous offline dinosaur runner! Leap over desert cacti, duck under flying pterodactyls, and sprint through accelerating speeds.
controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0'><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#090d16;color:#e2e8f0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;padding:10px}canvas{background:#0f172a;border:2px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)}</style></head><body><canvas id='c' width='600' height='260'></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),w=600,h=260,ground=210;let dino={x:50,y:ground-40,w:36,h:40,vy:0,jumping:false};let obstacles=[],speed=6,score=0,high=localStorage.getItem('dino_high')||0,gameOver=false;function jump(){if(!dino.jumping&&!gameOver){dino.vy=-10.5;dino.jumping=true}if(gameOver){score=0;speed=6;obstacles=[];gameOver=false;dino.y=ground-40;dino.vy=0;dino.jumping=false}}window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key===' '||e.key==='ArrowUp'){e.preventDefault();jump()}});c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();jump()});function loop(){if(!gameOver){score++;if(score>high){high=score;localStorage.setItem('dino_high',high)}if(score%500===0)speed+=0.5;if(dino.jumping){dino.vy+=0.6;dino.y+=dino.vy;if(dino.y>=ground-dino.h){dino.y=ground-dino.h;dino.vy=0;dino.jumping=false}}if(obstacles.length===0||obstacles[obstacles.length-1].x<w-200-Math.random()*150){const isDouble=Math.random()>0.7;obstacles.push({x:w,w:isDouble?32:18,h:isDouble?36:30,y:ground-(isDouble?36:30)})}obstacles.forEach(o=>{o.x-=speed;if(dino.x+dino.w-6>o.x&&dino.x+6<o.x+o.w&&dino.y+dino.h-4>o.y){gameOver=true}});obstacles=obstacles.filter(o=>o.x>-40)}ctx.fillStyle='#0f172a';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.strokeStyle='#334155';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,ground);ctx.lineTo(w,ground);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle='#38bdf8';ctx.fillRect(dino.x,dino.y,dino.w,dino.h);ctx.fillStyle='#0f172a';ctx.fillRect(dino.x+dino.w-10,dino.y+6,4,4);ctx.fillStyle='#22c55e';obstacles.forEach(o=>{ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,o.h)});ctx.font='bold 16px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#94a3b8';ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText('HI '+String(high).padStart(5,'0')+'  '+String(score).padStart(5,'0'),w-20,30);if(gameOver){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.font='bold 24px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',w/2,h/2-10);ctx.font='14px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('Press SPACE or Tap to Retry',w/2,h/2+18)}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(loop);</script></body></html>

title: Asteroids Vector Defense
description: Command your triangular spacecraft inside an asteroid field. Rotate, thrust with inertia physics, and blast space rocks into dust.
srcDoc: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0'><style>*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}body{background:#090d16;color:#e2e8f0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:100vh;overflow:hidden;padding:10px}canvas{background:#000;border:2px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)}</style></head><body><canvas id='c' width='500' height='450'></canvas><script>const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),w=500,h=450;let ship={x:250,y:225,r:12,a:0,rot:0,thrust:false,vx:0,vy:0};let lasers=[],asteroids=[],score=0,lives=3,gameOver=false,keys={};function spawnAsteroids(n=4){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let x,y;do{x=Math.random()*w;y=Math.random()*h}while(Math.hypot(x-ship.x,y-ship.y)<100);asteroids.push({x,y,r:30,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*2,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*2})}}spawnAsteroids();window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;if(e.key===' '&&!gameOver){lasers.push({x:ship.x+Math.cos(ship.a)*ship.r,y:ship.y+Math.sin(ship.a)*ship.r,vx:Math.cos(ship.a)*8,vy:Math.sin(ship.a)*8,life:60})}if(gameOver&&(e.key===' '||e.key==='Enter')){score=0;lives=3;gameOver=false;ship.x=250;ship.y=225;ship.vx=0;ship.vy=0;asteroids=[];spawnAsteroids()}});window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false});function update(){if(gameOver)return;if(keys['ArrowLeft']||keys['a'])ship.a-=0.08;if(keys['ArrowRight']||keys['d'])ship.a+=0.08;ship.thrust=keys['ArrowUp']||keys['w'];if(ship.thrust){ship.vx+=Math.cos(ship.a)*0.15;ship.vy+=Math.sin(ship.a)*0.15}ship.vx*=0.985;ship.vy*=0.985;ship.x=(ship.x+ship.vx+w)%w;ship.y=(ship.y+ship.vy+h)%h;lasers.forEach(l=>{l.x=(l.x+l.vx+w)%w;l.y=(l.y+l.vy+h)%h;l.life--});lasers=lasers.filter(l=>l.life>0);asteroids.forEach(a=>{a.x=(a.x+a.vx+w)%w;a.y=(a.y+a.vy+h)%h;if(Math.hypot(a.x-ship.x,a.y-ship.y)<a.r+ship.r){lives--;if(lives<=0)gameOver=true;else{ship.x=w/2;ship.y=h/2;ship.vx=0;ship.vy=0}}});lasers.forEach((l,li)=>{asteroids.forEach((a,ai)=>{if(Math.hypot(l.x-a.x,l.y-a.y)<a.r){score+=a.r>20?20:a.r>12?50:100;l.life=0;if(a.r>16){asteroids.push({x:a.x,y:a.y,r:a.r/2,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*3,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*3});asteroids.push({x:a.x,y:a.y,r:a.r/2,vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*3,vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*3})}asteroids.splice(ai,1)}})});if(asteroids.length===0)spawnAsteroids(5)}function draw(){ctx.fillStyle='#000';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.strokeStyle='#fff';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.save();ctx.translate(ship.x,ship.y);ctx.rotate(ship.a);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(ship.r,0);ctx.lineTo(-ship.r,-ship.r*0.6);ctx.lineTo(-ship.r*0.5,0);ctx.lineTo(-ship.r,ship.r*0.6);ctx.closePath();ctx.stroke();if(ship.thrust){ctx.strokeStyle='#f97316';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-ship.r*0.6,0);ctx.lineTo(-ship.r*1.4,0);ctx.stroke()}ctx.restore();ctx.strokeStyle='#38bdf8';lasers.forEach(l=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(l.x,l.y,2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke()});ctx.strokeStyle='#94a3b8';asteroids.forEach(a=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(a.x,a.y,a.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke()});ctx.font='bold 16px monospace';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('SCORE: '+score,20,30);ctx.fillText('LIVES: '+lives,w-100,30);if(gameOver){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.font='bold 28px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#ef4444';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('GAME OVER',w/2,h/2-10);ctx.font='15px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText('Press SPACE to Restart',w/2,h/2+20);ctx.textAlign='left'}}function loop(){update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(loop);</script></body></html>
